raw_segments.text: Might manage a sketch. By Mr. and Mrs. L. M. Bloom. Invent a story for some proverb. Which time I used to try jotting down on my cuff what she said dressing.

Dislike dressing together, nicked myself shaving. Biting her nether lip, hooking the placket of her skirt. Timing her. 9.15. Did Roberts pay you yet? 9.2. What did Greta Conroy on? 9.23. What possessed me to buy this comb? 9.24. I'm swelled after that cabbage.
A speck of dust on the patent leather of her boot.
